title: Inaugural Coffee Chat: Connecting Students and Leaders
summary: As a new chapter, NUS ACM-W hosted its inaugural Coffee Chat for Master's and PhD students alongside SoC leadership for mentorship, shared experiences, and community building.
upcomingSummary: As a new chapter, we'd love to hear from you! Join us for a casual coffee chat to meet others in the community, learn about NUS ACM-W, and help shape our upcoming events and initiatives.
upcomingDescription:
As a new chapter, we would love to hear from you. This coffee chat is a chance to:
- meet others in the community
- learn more about NUS ACM-W
- tell us about the opportunities and events you want to see
- help shape the future of our chapter

No prior involvement is needed, just come by, grab a coffee, and have a chat!
recapSummary: NUS ACM-W hosted its inaugural Coffee Chat, bringing together Master's and PhD students alongside SoC leadership for an inspiring afternoon of mentorship, shared experiences, and community building.
recapDescription:
On 12th August 2026, the NUS ACM-W Student Chapter hosted its very first inaugural event, a warm and welcoming Coffee Chat, held at COM 2.

The session brought together a vibrant group of Master's and PhD students across computing disciplines to connect, converse, and build lasting peer networks.

We were deeply honored to be joined by distinguished School of Computing leadership:
- Dr. Tulika Mitra, Dean, School of Computing
- Dr. Cristina Carbunaru, Assistant Dean, Student Life
- Dr. Bimlesh Wadhwa, Vice-Dean, Student Life

Our faculty generously shared invaluable wisdom and guidance on navigating academic life, career growth, personal well-being, and finding balance in graduate studies. It was truly inspiring to witness students and mentors find a safe, open space to exchange personal stories, challenges, and insights.

We wrapped up the afternoon filled with gratitude, shared aspirations, and a renewed commitment to support one another and grow together as a chapter. Thank you to everyone who made our inaugural event so meaningful!

title: Welcoming Freshmen at SoC Official Welcome 2026
summary: NUS ACM-W welcomed the incoming Class of 2026 at the SoC Official Welcome for Freshmen at the University Cultural Centre. Our EXCO connected with enthusiastic freshmen, sharing our mission to support, celebrate, and amplify women and gender-diverse students in computing.
description:
On 5th August 2026, NUS ACM-W hosted an engaging booth at the School of Computing (SoC) Official Welcome for Freshmen held at the University Cultural Centre.

Our Executive Committee (EXCO) had a wonderful time meeting and connecting with an energetic crowd of incoming undergraduate students. Throughout the session, we introduced freshmen to NUS ACM-W's core pillars:
- **Building Community:** Fostering an inclusive, supportive network for women and gender-diverse students across computing.
- **Sharing Experiences:** Connecting students with peer support, mentorship, and inspiring community stories.
- **Amplifying Impact:** Empowering students to excel in computing research, education, and career development.

Thank you to everyone who dropped by our booth! We are thrilled to welcome the Class of 2026 to SoC and look forward to seeing you at our upcoming chapter events.
